headline: Britain detains sanctioned oil tanker believed to be linked to Russia's shadow fleet
context: Britain is investigating a sanctioned tanker that is suspected of being part of the Russian "shadow fleet," shipping oil in violation of international sanctions over Moscow's war on Ukraine.

sources.name: NPR
